business_summary: Zhejiang Zhongxin Fluoride Materials Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of fine fluorine chemicals in China and internationally. The company offers basic chemicals, including hydrofluoric acid, fluorobenzene, p-fluorotoluene, p-fluorobenzoyl chloride, para-fluorobenzonitrile, orthofluorobenzonitrile, and o-fluorotoluene; environmentally friendly refrigerants, such as HFC-245fa, HFO-1233zd(E), HFO-1233zd(Z), HFO-1243zf, HFO-1234ze, and HFO-1234yf; and pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates. It also provides new material products, such as 4,4'-difluorobenzophenone; parylene F; parylene HT; N,N'-dimethylpiperazine; and 2,2'-bis(trifluoromethyl)benzidine. In addition, the company offers new energy materials and electronics-grade chemicals, including sodium fluoride; sodium hexafluorophosphate; lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)amide; 4-fluoro-1,3-dioxolan-2-one; trifluoromethanesulfonyl chloride; lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt; spiro-(1,1)-bipyrrolidinium tetrafluoroborate; tetraethylammonium tetrafluoroborate; triethylmethylammonium tetrafluoroborate; N,N-dimethylpyrrolidinium; and sodium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide. Further, it engages in the trading of chemical raw materials and fine chemical products; mining and processing of fluorite powder; and trading activities. The company serves the pharmaceutical, pesticide, new materials, and electronic chemicals sectors. Zhejiang Zhongxin Fluoride Materials Co.,Ltd was founded in 2000 and is based in Shaoxing, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhejiang Zhongxin Fluoride Materials Co.,Ltd는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 정밀 불소 화학물질의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 불화수소산, 플루오로벤젠, p-플루오로톨루엔, p-플루오로벤조일 클로라이드, 파라-플루오로벤조니트릴, 오르토플루오로벤조니트릴 및 o-플루오로톨루엔을 포함한 기본 화학 물질을 제공합니다. HFC-245fa, HFO-1233zd(E), HFO-1233zd(Z), HFO-1243zf, HFO-1234ze, HFO-1234yf 등의 친환경 냉매; 및 제약 및 살충제 중간체. 또한 4,4'-디플루오로벤조페논과 같은 신소재 제품도 제공합니다. 파릴렌 F; 파릴렌 HT; N,N'-디메틸피페라진; 및 2,2'-비스(트리플루오로메틸)벤지딘. 또한 이 회사는 불화나트륨을 포함한 신에너지 소재와 전자 등급 화학 물질을 제공합니다. 헥사플루오로인산나트륨; 리튬 비스(플루오로술포닐)아미드; 4-플루오로-1,3-디옥솔란-2-온; 트리플루오로메탄설포닐 클로라이드; 리튬 비스(트리플루오로메탄술포닐)이미드 염; 스피로-(1,1)-바이피롤리디늄 테트라플루오로보레이트; 테트라에틸암모늄 테트라플루오로보레이트; 트리에틸메틸암모늄 테트라플루오로보레이트; N,N-디메틸피롤리디늄; 및 나트륨 비스(플루오로술포닐)
